summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of GreatWorks Foundation institutional NGO redesign. Tested utility bar (a11y font+/-, contrast, EN/FR language, helpline/email), primary nav (9 items), search flow, home hero + fact panel + announcements + indicators + programs, /programs, /projects with filters + detail dialog, /impact indicators+results table, /publications tabs, /partnerships segmented cards, /contact form + map, /donate presets + submit, /get-involved volunteer form, footer newsletter, /stories, /gallery, and /admin redirect. All 15 major flows work. Form submissions verified via network (200 OK on /api/contact, /api/donations, /api/volunteers, /api/newsletter) and sonner toast rendered.

issues: React hydration warnings: dev tooling injects <span> wrappers inside <select> (options) and <tbody> (Impact table rows), producing 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <select>/<tbody>' warnings. Non-blocking but noisy in console.
Only 2 of 4 rendered project cards expose a '-view' button; verify that all project cards intended to open the detail dialog have the trigger. If some cards intentionally have no dialog, ignore.

action_items: (Low) Investigate React hydration warnings on Projects <select> options and Impact <tbody> rows caused by dev-tooling <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers inside array maps - this appears to be from an external x-source-var wrapper and is only visible in dev mode.
(Low) Ensure every visible project card renders a view button consistently, or hide cards that cannot open a detail dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 734 lines - consider splitting per resource CRUD sub-components (guideline: >700 lines).
Sonner toasts render only briefly; if tests need to assert on them, expose a persistent aria-live region or data-testid on the toast container.
Multiple 401 responses in console on public pages (likely admin/CMS pre-fetches). Guard those calls behind auth state to reduce console noise.
seed_data_creation: Created test submissions: contact (Test User), donation ($75, Test Donor), volunteer (TEST Volunteer), newsletter (test-news@example.com). All prefixed/identifiable as automated tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 required flows are functional. Notes: (1) contrast toggle applies class 'a11y-contrast' on <html>, not 'high-contrast'. (2) Project view buttons follow pattern [data-testid$='-view'] under project-{n}. (3) Toasts are sonner - use [data-sonner-toast] selector, not body text. (4) 401 console errors on public pages are from admin CMS endpoints and are non-blocking. (5) Hydration warnings only appear in dev overlay tooling, not real prod bugs. Skipped: admin CRUD (no password), publications documents (empty state expected).
